en: The Dyad on that which is not-root but with-root (Nahetusahetukaduka)
Dependent on a rootless state with root, a non-root, non-rooted state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root;

four in the case of object; five in the case of predominance … pe … six in the case of mutuality … pe … two in the cases of prenascence and repetition … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance. (The “Conascent” section … pe … and the “Investigation” section should also be expanded in detail.
